deployments_detail.use: Bogasari Flour Mills (Indofood milling division) Industry 4.0 digitalization at its Cibitung plant using Buhler's Mercury Manufacturing Execution System and the Buhler Insights IoT platform, enabling autonomous/self-regulating process control, real-time data on raw materials and resource consumption, and 24/7 global remote diagnostics and maintenance. Automation/IoT-led with autonomous regulation; the source does not detail specific ML models. [Buhler (Mercury MES, Buhler Insights)]
AI-powered marketing campaign via Indomilk Steril brand (AI-generated personalized video calls from celebrity Ariel)

Indomilk Steril 'Click to get Riil' campaign: AI-generated interactive packaging that let consumers receive a personalized video call from singer Ariel NOAH, who addressed callers by name with motivational messages. Billed as the first AI-driven consumer campaign of its kind in Indonesia, across 12 special-edition packs. [none]
